diode_load_diff_pair.topology: NFET diff pair (L=1 W=8) + diode-connected PMOS loads (L=4 W=2)
known_issues: Low gain limits dynamic range — may need hybrid loads for >= 225mV span

hybrid_mirror_diode_load.topology: Reference side: diode PMOS. Output side: active mirror PMOS + parallel diode PMOS.
known_issues: Process variation on mirror/diode ratio affects gain +/-20%

transmission_gate_sh.topology: NFET (L=0.5 W=2) + PMOS (L=0.5 W=4), 2pF MIM hold cap
transmission_gate_sh.charge_injection: NFET injects -deltaQ, PMOS injects +deltaQ, partial cancellation
known_issues: ~1-2ns propagation delay between NFET and PMOS gates — negligible at ms timescale

nfet_pass_gate_sh.topology: Single NFET (L=0.5 W=2), 2pF MIM hold cap
nfet_pass_gate_sh.leakage: Sub-threshold leakage exponentially reduced with gate at 0V. Practical hold time > 100ms.

self_biased_current_source.topology: PMOS (L=8 W=0.42) + asymmetric NFET (L=8 W=0.42 / L=12 W=0.42)
known_issues: Requires .ic for simulation startup. Needs startup circuit in silicon.

ccia_instrumentation_amplifier.topology: 5T OTA (L=8 W=2) + Cin=10pF + Cfb=0.098pF + pseudo-resistors (PMOS L=10 W=0.42)
known_issues: Gain=103 slightly above target 100. Manufacturing variation on 0.098pF cap could shift gain +/-10%.

rc_timer_with_sf.topology: Dual timer: Main (100pF, ~0.52mV/ms) + Fast (~4pF, ~21mV/ms). Source follower buffer. 7 two-stage comparators.
known_issues: SF decay rate depends on bias current. Per-comparator pipeline delay calibration required.

lazzaro_wta.topology: 5 input cells with shared inhibition node. 16 transistors. NMOS input W=2 L=0.5, PFET load W=4 L=0.5.
known_issues: 10uA bias is high for ultra-low-power — but only active during brief classification phase. May not resolve margins < 1%.
